$comment: Motion sections family. scripts/build-registry.mjs turns every entry in `items` into a registry item at /r/<name>.json; apps/docs/scripts/build-catalog.mjs turns them into /templates/<name> pages. License tier per item lives in source/licenses.json.
title: Motion sections
intro: Eleven sections built around one motion idea each, in HeiGin's own style: rolling prices, stacking cards, a fly-in hero, a header that folds into a floating pill, a process rail a bead draws as you scroll, a two-panel drawer menu, a hover index, a diagonal gallery, a feature dialog, a scaling photo conveyor and a line-by-line text reveal. No animation library; each installs on its own.
previewNote: Shown with the HeiGin brand and sample content. The photos and HeiGin UI screenshots in the preview are not part of the download; empty image slots draw a soft gradient.
requirements: @heigin/ui 0.2.0 or newer (for Badge, VisuallyHidden and HeiGinMark)
A "@/" import alias pointing at your source root (the shadcn default)
setup: Install the item with the shadcn CLI. It adds the files listed above plus motion-core, which every section shares.
Import the stylesheet once in your global CSS, after Tailwind and the HeiGin tokens: @import "tailwindcss"; @import "@heigin/ui/styles.css"; @import "@heigin/ui/tailwind.css"; @import "./motion.css";
Edit lib/motion-config.ts: brand, copy, plans, links and your images all live there.

items.name: motion-core
items.title: Motion core
items.description: Shared foundation for the motion sections: the content config, the easing curves and the scroll-catch-up helper every section uses, and the stylesheet.
items.responsive: Shared pieces only; each section documents its own breakpoints.
replaceable: Brand: the HeiGin mark and name until brand.logoSrc and brand.name are set.

items.name: motion-pricing
items.title: Rolling pricing
items.description: Three plan cards with a monthly/yearly switch. Flip it and every price rolls to its new number digit by digit, gaining or dropping a column as the number grows or shrinks, while the knob smears along its track, a savings chip pops in and each plan name carries a slow shimmer.
items.responsive: Cards sit in three columns from 768px and stack below that.
replaceable: Plans, prices, features and links are sample content in lib/motion-config.ts.

items.name: motion-stacking-cards
items.title: Stacking cards
items.description: A stack of cards that holds the screen while you scroll. Each new card slides up through a fixed frame and covers the last one, which closes in from its edges, tilts and sinks underneath. A counter keeps your place, and a click on it jumps to any card.
items.responsive: The frame keeps an 8:5 card at every width and fits the screen height.
replaceable: Card photos: add a src per card in lib/motion-config.ts; cards without one show a gradient.

items.name: motion-fly-in
items.title: Fly-in hero
items.description: A dark hero where cards keep flying in from deep inside the page toward the viewer, fading in and out around a clear centre that holds the headline. The whole field glides with the cursor, scrolling speeds it up for a moment, and the headline rises in line by line.
items.responsive: Full screen height; cards marked hideMobile drop out below 768px, and touch screens skip the cursor pan.
replaceable: Cards: add your own images to flyIn.items; with none, it draws gradient placeholders.

items.name: motion-floating-navbar
items.title: Floating navbar
items.description: A header that sits wide open over your hero and folds into a small dark floating pill once the page scrolls: its edges close in, the name folds behind the mark and the links tighten toward the centre. Scroll back to the top and it opens up again.
items.responsive: Links show from 768px; below that the pill holds the mark and the call to action.
replaceable: Links, the call to action and the fold threshold live in lib/motion-config.ts.

items.name: motion-process-rail
items.title: Process rail
items.description: A how-it-works row of steps along a line. As you scroll, a bead draws the line behind it, and each step lights up as the bead reaches it: its number rolls in and its image fades and scales in underneath. A click on a step scrolls the page there.
items.responsive: From 768px the stage holds the screen while the bead travels; on phones the steps stack and all show at once.
replaceable: Steps and their images live in lib/motion-config.ts; a step without an image shows its text only.

items.name: motion-drawer-menu
items.title: Drawer menu
items.description: A header with a Menu button that sweeps a drawer open from the left edge while the page dims. The label rolls to Close, the icon closes into an X and the items slide in one by one. Hovering a category opens a second panel beside it, and moving to another swaps its links.
items.responsive: From 768px the second panel opens beside the first on hover; on phones a tap slides it in over the first, with a back button.
replaceable: Categories, links, the two cards and the footer links live in lib/motion-config.ts; cards without a photo show a gradient.

items.name: motion-hover-index
items.title: Hover index
items.description: A dark section with a long list of names that brightens around the pointer like a lens, gliding between rows as it moves. The nearest name's photo wipes in over the last one from the side the lens is heading.
items.responsive: Full screen height. From 768px the list sits centred with the photo card on its last row; on phones the list starts at the top and the card sits in the bottom corner. Touch screens move the lens by tap.
replaceable: Names, links and photos live in lib/motion-config.ts; a name without a photo shows a gradient.

items.name: motion-diagonal-gallery
items.title: Diagonal gallery
items.description: A gallery that holds the screen while you scroll. Each photo moves up from the bottom-right corner to take the centre and pushes the last one to the top left, while its caption swaps line by line and a large step number rolls to match.
items.responsive: The photo keeps a 3:4 shape and fits the screen height; on phones the caption moves under the photo and the step number hides.
replaceable: The headline, captions and photos live in lib/motion-config.ts; photos without a src show a gradient.

items.name: motion-feature-dialog
items.title: Feature dialog
items.description: A feature tile that opens a detail sheet. The page dims and blurs, the sheet rises in from the bottom of the window, and on close it drops away on a quicker leg of its own. Either can interrupt the other. Built on the native dialog element, so focus stays inside and Escape closes it.
items.responsive: The tile lays out side by side from 768px and stacks below that; the sheet fills the width on phones.
replaceable: Tile and sheet copy, the stats and every image live in lib/motion-config.ts; images without a src show a gradient.

items.name: motion-scale-slider
items.title: Scale slider
items.description: A conveyor of square photos on one baseline, each a fixed ratio larger than the one behind it, so they shrink smoothly as they travel and leave the edge still a third of the lead photo's size. It drifts on its own, speeds up while the page scrolls, follows a drag and steps one photo with the arrows or the arrow keys.
items.responsive: Full screen height; wider screens show more photos (three to six), so the lead photo never outgrows the height.
replaceable: Photos live in lib/motion-config.ts; slides without a src show a gradient. Add at least seven for the widest screens.

items.name: motion-text-reveal
items.title: Text reveal
items.description: A large statement that rises into place line by line, each line out of its own mask, the first time it scrolls into view. The parts you mark strong read in full ink and the rest in muted grey.
items.responsive: Lines are measured from the real layout and re-measured on resize, so the reveal follows however the text wraps.
replaceable: The statement lives in lib/motion-config.ts as a list of segments.
